description:
MARFORRES 4th Reconnaissance Battalion is requesting information for capability statements for full-time Small Craft Mechanic services to perform maintanence and operations across (5) geographical locations within 4th Marine Division. All performance requirements and location specifics are located within the Performance Work Statement attached. 

This is a Request for Information (RFI) issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation (Request for Quotation) or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. This RFI does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. The Government will not pay for information requested, nor will it compensate any respondent for any cost incurred in developing information provided to the Government. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary.
